report: 解析搜索资源独立验收-R3.md

findings.title: Late old-book task releases current new-book image through colliding numeric owner
findings.actual: Old book owner 2 finishes after new book owner 2 is displayed. reader calls state.book.releaseTask(2) on NEW; new image URL is revoked, resource/task sets empty, DOM still references URL and ready remains true.
findings.boundary: Original full reader events and real parser, deterministic URL ledger, iframe/layout doubles; not rendered image evidence.

findings.title: Query change during result navigation still commits old highlight
findings.actual: Click OLDQUERY result, block readText, input NEWQUERY, release read. activeSearchResult queryGen 3 with state.searchGen 4; Range highlight OLDQUERY.
findings.boundary: Original reader/Range with layout dependency double; final browser geometry remains parent scope.

findings.title: Sparse and no-match scans have no macrotask yield
findings.actual: Hot index of 8388608 UTF-16 units with zero/one match or 64 zero-match sections returns before queued cancellation timer runs. Dense match case passes.
findings.boundary: Measured failed inputs around 0.5-6.9ms in Node; no claim these specific inputs severely freeze browser. Cold DOM parse isolated at about 81.7ms is an observation.

findings.title: Hidden br and SVG presentation semantics differ from text model
findings.actual: A<br hidden>B indexed as A newline B and AB misses. SVG visibility hidden, display none, and unused symbol strings each produce a hit despite preserved markup.
findings.boundary: Established DOM/model mismatch; browser visibility not executed. aria-hidden-only and SVG use are policy/gap observations, not separate failures.

findings.title: IDPF target validation ignores ZIP absence and uses font MIME substring
findings.actual: Exact IDPF plus manifest font/otf but missing ZIP entry opens with fontObfuscated=true; application/x-not-a-font and text/x-woff-comment also accepted.
findings.boundary: Real ZIP and original open/init classification; no decryption or font decoding assertion.

findings.title: Early prepare failures retain unbounded empty task records
findings.actual: 40 readText failures in prepareSection leave 40 task sets with resources=0 and pending=0.
findings.boundary: Empty metadata sets only; does not demonstrate leaked image payloads or unbounded process memory.
